name: Brightheart Meditation Center
reason: Effectively a duplicate of Finnbarr Kennedy's listing: brightheartmeditation.com is his personal site (already his website_url on Spiritpedia), the 'centre' is his hermitage yurt in Zalaszentlászló, Hungary, and its YouTube channel, online sittings and book are his own. As a separate organisation it would be too thin (donation-based online sittings and informal retreats with no pages of their own).
